method: Interpret each already-frozen functional-synthesis relation F0(W,B) as one block projection PROJECT(E=W) to R_post(B)=exists W F0(W,B)=D(B), then map the already-frozen witness DAG and independent verification to one block DISCHARGE_WITNESS. No source, constructor, verifier, proof node, metric or verdict is regenerated.

common_kernel_mapping.project_step: PROJECT the complete witness-output block W. The post relation is exactly the previously certified domain D(B)=exists W F0(W,B).
common_kernel_mapping.discharge_step: Use the already-frozen proof-carrying witness roots as the total completion term f_W(B), with the already-frozen independent verifier result as the accepted local extension authority for the original relation.
common_kernel_mapping.dependency_DAG: Trivial one-receipt block. f_W depends only on retained boundary/input variables B, so WF2 is satisfied without cross-receipt dependencies.
common_kernel_mapping.terminal_role: Existing domain certificate plus witness proof package has the form (D,f_W,pi_D,pi_f,Omega_closed) under the retrospective kernel interpretation.

relation_view.boundary_B: implicit majority relation input bits y_1..y_n

debt_mapping.PROJECT: W: LIVE -> DEBT; post relation is TRUE
debt_mapping.DISCHARGE: witness_root gives f_W(B); independent verifier establishes the required relation-level witness property on the total domain

relation_view.witness_block_W: LSB-first binary code of a violated vertex; |W|=log2(n) on the frozen powers-of-two series
relation_view.relation: F0(W,Y) holds when W names a vertex v with viol_v(Y)=1

existing_frozen_objects.pi_D: AFFINE_XOR_SUM_CERTIFICATE with normal form constant=1 and empty support

debt_mapping.PROJECT: Entire W block: LIVE -> DEBT; exact projection is TRUE because the frozen odd-charge proof certifies exists violated vertex for every Y.
debt_mapping.DISCHARGE: The frozen witness roots form total f_W(Y); the independent verifier already checked that the selected code denotes a violated vertex.

relation_view.boundary_B: frozen raw affine source bits Y
relation_view.witness_block_W: LSB-first binary code of a vertex with exact mixed guard G_v(Y)=1

existing_frozen_objects.Pi_guard: raw affine atoms -> OR3 via GUARDED_ITE -> NOT OR3 -> exact mixed guard roots
existing_frozen_objects.Pi_select: priority selector witness roots; e.g. n=16: w_0=m93, w_1=m107, w_2=m119, w_3=m127

debt_mapping.PROJECT: Entire W block: LIVE -> DEBT; exact projection is TRUE by the frozen independent Pi_domain proof.
debt_mapping.DISCHARGE: Pi_guard + Pi_select provide total f_W(Y), and the independent verifier checked the exact mixed-guard selection semantics.

important_limits.reason: The old artifacts were not generated in the new debt-receipt schema. This document proves a semantic correspondence of already-verified fields to the abstract kernel roles; it does not rerun a new kernel checker.

consequence.positive: The Debt Kernel is not disconnected from the prior U-PAIR-1J experimental line: three already-frozen proof-carrying synthesis families instantiate its PROJECT -> DISCHARGE -> DEBT_FREE pattern without new computation.
consequence.negative: These examples are all total-domain, one-block witness projections with trivial receipt dependency DAGs. They do not yet exercise the hard case that motivated T5: multiple sequential projections with nontrivial reconstruction dependencies and reverse composition.
consequence.next_theory_target: Find an already-existing frozen JANUS artifact, if any, containing at least two sequential exact projections whose earlier witness rule depends on variables projected later. Reinterpret it before designing any new experiment. If no such frozen artifact exists, keep the need as a formal coverage gap rather than immediately creating a hostile.
